title: Combinatorial constructions of Schubert subspace codes
summary: We study Schubert subspace codes, which are constant-dimension subspace codes with prescribed intersection conditions with a fixed subspace. Our goal is to construct codes of maximum possible size in the extremal distance cases where a natural counting upper bound applies. We give two families of constructions. The first one uses a direct-sum decomposition of the ambient space, together with partial spreads and colorings of powers of $q$-Johnson graphs.
